cards.name: Brightness & Contrast
cards.summary: Simple global brightness and contrast adjustment for the whole clip. Quick fix or stylised punch, without Lumetri's curves and wheels.
use_for: Lift a slightly underexposed press or archive photo before it goes into an explainer
Add punch to flat stock B-roll in a news reel
Quick white flash on a beat (keyframe Brightness up and back)
Darken a background clip so a lower third or caption reads better
avoid: Large Contrast values clip highlights and crush shadows: faces and white kurtas lose detail
Using it as the main grade: Lumetri Color gives far more control at the same cost

params.name: Brightness
params.does: Shifts all tones up or down

params.name: Contrast
params.does: Expands or compresses the tonal range around mid-grey
params.typical: 10..30 for punch, negative for a faded look

cards.scripting: Both properties are plain numbers -100..100, 0 = no change. Keyframeable. Stacking order matters: put it after any effect that changes colour (e.g. Black & White) if you want to punch the result. Measured 2026-10-13 (live wave 2, the layout recipes' blurred backplates): at the same values (Brightness -35 / -45, Contrast -10) Premiere's Brightness & Contrast renders 10-27 levels darker than After Effects' (ADBE Brightness & Contrast 2): 9:16 blur-fill mean RGB 104/103/105 in Premiere against 126/115/127 in After Effects. The two scales are not the same: do not copy values across apps without a check.

verified.note: Whole frame clearly brighter and punchier (mean luma 98 -> 133, contrast up): cream wall lifts toward white, dark clothing stays dark.

cards.name: Basic 3D
cards.summary: Rotates the clip in simple 3D space (swivel around the vertical axis, tilt around the horizontal axis) and moves it nearer or farther, like a flat card in perspective.
use_for: Swing a screenshot, document or tweet card into frame in an explainer
Tilt a press photo into a 3D 'floating evidence' panel for a political explainer
Card flip between two shots (swivel 0 to 90 on the out clip, -90 to 0 on the in clip)
Give a picture-in-picture a subtle angled TV-screen look in a news package
avoid: Large swivel on full-frame footage exposes black edges; scale the clip down or put a background track under it
Show Specular Highlight looks dated (early-2000s glint) if left on
Draw Preview Wireframe is only a draft aid; never leave it on for export

params.name: Swivel
params.does: Rotation around the vertical (Y) axis in degrees

params.name: Tilt
params.does: Rotation around the horizontal (X) axis in degrees

params.name: Distance to Image
params.does: Moves the card away (positive, smaller) or toward the camera (negative, larger)
params.typical: 0..50 to push back, -20..0 to bring closer

params.name: Show Specular Highlight
params.does: Adds a light glint reflecting off the rotated surface

params.name: Draw Preview Wireframe
params.does: Shows a wireframe outline in draft previews only

cards.equivalent: Basic 3D (in AE's Obsolete folder; a 3D layer with a camera is the modern AE route)
cards.scripting: Swivel and Tilt are degrees (harvested clamp -32768..32767, so full turns are possible). Distance to Image clamps -30000..30000; values beyond about 100 make the clip tiny. The two booleans are true/false. For a card flip, keyframe Swivel on both clips and cut at the 90-degree point.

verified.note: Picture is swivelled and tilted into a smaller perspective card floating on black, the 3D-card look.

cards.name: Black & White
cards.summary: Converts the clip to greyscale with no controls. One-click monochrome.
use_for: Flashback or 'then' half of a then-vs-now comparison in a documentary
Archival feel for historical segments in a political explainer
Freeze-frame callout: drop the frame to black and white while a highlighted subject stays in colour on a track above
Sombre tone for tribute or condolence news reels
avoid: On its own it can look flat and grey; add contrast after it
No controls and not keyframeable: for a gradual fade to mono use Lumetri Color Saturation keyframes instead
cards.equivalent: Black & White (AE's version adds per-colour sliders and a tint option; Premiere's has none)
cards.scripting: The effect has no properties: apply it with {"name": "Black & White", "pr_props": {}}. demo_settings is empty by design, because applying it IS the demo and makes the frame fully greyscale. Toggle it on/off rather than keyframing; for an animated colour-to-mono transition use Lumetri Color Saturation or cross-dissolve to a duplicate clip with this effect.

verified.note: Frame is fully greyscale (zero chroma) with tones preserved, clean one-click monochrome.

cards.name: Block Dissolve
cards.summary: Makes the clip disappear in random rectangular blocks as Transition Completion rises, revealing what is on the track below (or black).
use_for: Digital/data-themed reveal between two shots in an AI or tech explainer
Break a screenshot or graphic apart to reveal the next visual
Transition into a 'hacked' or 'leaked document' segment in a news reel
Blocky disintegrate of a title card
avoid: Tiny blocks (1-4 px) look like noise rather than a deliberate transition
Without a clip on the track below it dissolves to black, which may look like a dropout

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: Percent of the clip that has dissolved away

params.name: Block Width
params.does: Width of each block in pixels

params.name: Block Height
params.does: Height of each block in pixels

cards.scripting: It is an effect, not a transition: apply it to the outgoing clip on the upper track, overlap the incoming clip below, and keyframe Transition Completion 0 to 100. There is no seed property, so the block order cannot be changed from a spec. Block sizes are pixels (1..32000; the default 1 x 1 reads as noise, so always set them).

verified.note: About half the picture is knocked out in random hard-edged rectangular blocks of black, a clear digital block breakup.

cards.name: Blue Screen Key
cards.summary: Legacy keyer that makes blue-screen pixels transparent using a threshold and cutoff. Superseded by Ultra Key. On footage without a blue screen it cuts no matte: lowering Threshold just fades the whole picture semi-transparent.
use_for: Opening old projects that already use it
Rough key of a well-lit blue screen anchor shot when Ultra Key is not wanted
avoid: Edges and spill handling are much worse than Ultra Key; hair and motion blur fringe badly
Only keys blue; useless on green screen
On footage with no real blue screen a low Threshold fades the entire clip instead of keying anything

params.name: Threshold
params.does: How much blue counts as background (lower = more keyed)

params.name: Cutoff
params.does: Pushes the matte so semi-transparent areas become more opaque

cards.scripting: Legacy (match name 'Legacy Key'): use Ultra Key for new work. The unnamed boolean row is Mask Only and cannot be addressed by name. Threshold default 100 keys nothing; lower it to start keying. Render-verified 2026-10-03 on the warm PVE test clip: Threshold 40 (Smoothing Low) made the whole frame about 25% transparent with no holes, because there is no blue to key; the fade is not uniform (about 10% on warm skin and red areas, up to about 30% on neutral areas), so below 100 Threshold acts as a weak, colour-dependent transparency lever, not a clean global fade. Judge it only on real blue-screen footage.

verified.note: No blue in the shot so no matte is cut: the whole picture fades to about 75% opacity over black (warm skin/red areas fade less), exactly the semi-transparent fade the card describes.

cards.name: Broadcast Colors
cards.summary: Clamps or keys out pixels whose luminance or saturation exceeds broadcast-legal limits (NTSC/PAL IRE), for TV delivery.
use_for: Make a news package or documentary legal for a TV channel's QC
Tame over-saturated saffron/green flag colours and graphics before broadcast
Show which areas are illegal (Key Out Unsafe) while grading
avoid: Not needed for Instagram/YouTube-only delivery
Reduce Luminance on bright scenes can look dull; fix the grade in Lumetri first and use this only as a final safety
Leaving a Key Out mode on for export punches holes in the picture

params.name: How to Make Color Safe
params.does: Method: reduce luminance, reduce saturation, or key out unsafe/safe pixels

cards.equivalent: Broadcast Colors (AE); Premiere's Video Limiter is the more modern route
cards.scripting: How to Make Color Safe clamps 0..4 with a separator in slot 2: 0 Reduce Luminance, 1 Reduce Saturation, 2 separator, 3 Key Out Unsafe, 4 Key Out Safe. Render-verified 2026-10-03: 3 at 90 IRE keys the bright wall, desk lights and hot highlights to transparent (black over an empty track), so 3 is Key Out Unsafe. Its Effects-panel folder in Premiere 2026 is not verified (may sit in Obsolete); Video Limiter supersedes it for delivery work.

verified.note: Key Out Unsafe drops the bright wall, desk lights and hot highlights to black in ragged patches while the rest of the picture stays.

cards.name: Brush Strokes
cards.summary: Repaints the image as directional brush strokes, giving a rough painted look.
use_for: Painted look for historical recreation or 'freedom struggle' segments in a documentary
Stylised background plate behind a quote card
Dreamy/memory transition by keyframing in strokes over a still
avoid: Heavy and slow on 1080p/4K timelines; render previews
Looks cheap on faces of recognisable leaders; keep it to backgrounds or wide shots
Strokes shimmer frame to frame on moving footage; works best on stills or slow shots

params.name: Stroke Angle
params.does: Direction of the strokes in degrees

params.name: Stroke Randomness
params.does: Variation in stroke direction and length

params.name: Paint Surface
params.does: What the strokes are painted on (dropdown)

cards.scripting: Blend With Original is harvested as 0..1 (a fraction, not AE's 0-100 percent): use 0.5 for 50 percent. Brush Size clamps 0..5, Stroke Length 0..40, Density and Randomness 0..2. Paint Surface labels follow AE's popup order.

verified.note: Image is repainted with visible diagonal daubs over the wall, stripes and faces, a rough painterly look.

cards.name: Camera Blur
cards.summary: Simulates an out-of-focus camera lens with a single Percent Blur control.
use_for: Defocus a background clip behind a quote card or lower-third text
Fake rack focus into a shot at the start of a documentary scene
Blur-in/blur-out bookends on B-roll in a reel
avoid: CPU-only and slow at high values; Gaussian Blur is faster on GPU, and the newer Bokeh Blur / Focus Blur effects give a more lens-like defocus
Strong values soften and darken the frame edges; scale the clip up a few percent, or use Gaussian Blur (Legacy) with Repeat Edge Pixels for a clean edge
cards.scripting: Single number 0..100 (default 25, so applying it blurs immediately). Keyframeable. Its folder in Premiere 2026 is not verified (older builds: Blur & Sharpen); prefer Gaussian Blur when GPU speed matters.

verified.note: Whole frame is defocused into soft colour blobs with no readable detail, an obvious out-of-focus lens.

cards.name: Chroma Key
cards.summary: Legacy keyer that makes a chosen colour and similar colours transparent. Superseded by Ultra Key.
use_for: Opening old projects that already use it
Quick key of a flat-coloured graphic background when Ultra Key is not wanted
avoid: Poor spill suppression and edge quality compared to Ultra Key
Unevenly lit green screens leave blotches
A key colour near skin tone (beige or tan walls) also keys out faces and hands

params.name: Similarity
params.does: Range of colours around the key colour to remove

params.name: Blend
params.does: Blends the keyed clip with the clip below

params.name: Cutoff
params.does: Darkens or lightens shadows kept by Threshold

cards.scripting: Legacy (match name 'Legacy Key'): use Ultra Key for new work. Color is set as "#RRGGBB"; the harvested default is a packed 64-bit value (about 0xFF00FF00FF00FF00, i.e. probably white if read as 16-bit ARGB; low bits were lost in the harvest). The unnamed boolean row is Mask Only and cannot be addressed by name. Similarity 0 (default) keys nothing. Render-verified 2026-10-03: the demo (#C2A468, Similarity 15) keys out the beige wall of the PVE test clip and also most skin tones (skin goes black over an empty track); dark clothing, stripes and flowers stay.

verified.note: The beige wall and skin tones key out to black while dark clothing, stripes and flowers keep their original colours, a clear colour key.

cards.name: Cineon Converter
cards.summary: Converts between logarithmic Cineon/DPX film-scan encoding and linear video, with black/white points, gamma and highlight rolloff.
use_for: Normalise Cineon/DPX film scans used as archival footage in a documentary
Deliberately flatten a shot (Linear to Log) for a 'raw camera log' look in a filmmaking explainer
Rough-convert log-encoded stock footage before grading
avoid: On normal Rec.709 footage the default Log to Linear makes it overly contrasty and dark
For modern camera log (S-Log, LogC, V-Log) use Lumetri input LUTs or Color Space Transform instead

params.name: Highlight Rolloff
params.does: Compresses bright highlights to avoid hard clipping

cards.scripting: Conversion Type default 1 = Log to Linear (matches AE's default and the harvest). Internal Black/White Point are 0..1 fractions; 10 Bit points are 0..1023 code values. Demo uses 0 (Linear to Log), which makes ordinary footage visibly flat and milky.

verified.note: Linear to Log flattens the shot: lifted milky blacks, low contrast and muted colour, the expected flat log look.

cards.name: Clip Name
cards.summary: Burns the clip's name as text over the picture on a semi-transparent box, for review copies.
use_for: Rough-cut review exports so the producer can reference shots by name
Footage logging and selects reels for a documentary
Checking which stock or AI-generated clip version is in the edit
avoid: Never leave it on for the final export
Long file names overflow the frame at large Size

params.name: Position
params.does: Where the label sits, as frame fractions

params.name: Opacity
params.does: Opacity of the background box behind the text

cards.equivalent: none (in AE use a text layer whose Source Text expression reads the layer name)
cards.scripting: Ignore the internal rows '', 'Version2' and 'Source Track' (Source Track's harvested range is nonsense). Display is a 0..2 dropdown, probably Sequence Clip Name / Project Clip Name / File Name, but order is unverified. Apply on an adjustment layer to label every clip below only if Source Track is set in the UI; per-clip application is the reliable route.

verified.note: The clip name 'test_a.mp4' is burned in large white text on a dark semi-transparent box at bottom centre.

cards.name: Color Space Transform
cards.summary: Converts the clip from one colour space / transfer function to another (e.g. camera log or HDR to Rec.709), with tone mapping and gamut compression options. Part of Premiere's newer colour-management toolset.
use_for: Convert camera log footage (S-Log3, LogC, V-Log, Apple Log) to Rec.709 before grading a documentary
Tone-map HDR phone or drone clips to SDR for an Instagram reel
Match mixed-source interview footage into one working space
avoid: Wrong source space gives crushed, over-saturated or milky pictures; confirm the camera's log format first
Double conversion if Premiere's clip colour management already transforms the footage

params.name: Gain
params.does: Exposure gain applied in tone mapping

cards.scripting: SCS/TCS index-to-colour-space mapping was not harvested. Render check 2026-10-03: SCS 15 against TCS 0 produced no visible change on Rec.709 footage (max pixel difference 11/255, encoding noise), so writing the SCS index from a script does not select a colour space, most likely because the real choice lives in the unsettable 'SCS Arb Data' / 'TCS Arb Data' blobs. NEEDS INPUT: a person must pick source and target spaces in Effect Controls (and save a preset) and re-harvest the index/arb-data pairing before this can be scripted or demoed; demo_settings are left empty until then (SCS/TCS indices alone are a no-op). Folder unverified (Color Correction or Utility).

verified.note: Status needs_input, so it is not in this gallery run (no frame in index.json); an earlier render showed SCS/TCS index changes alone are a no-op without the arb-data blobs.
